2034-2111-6792.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Repeat.

413-4186-6854--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures also triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat from step 7.

1987-2187-3075.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2187-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters
1987-2187-3075.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-3075.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1267-4034-5231.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-4034-5231.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.

Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Medomai.
Repeat each turn.

The Equipment's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the Eldrazi from exile by paying {0} due to Eye of Ugin.

Kwain does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kwain.
2060-3525-5162-6996.description:
Activate Kwain by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Kwain.
Repeat.

1806-2034-2060-6627-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to The Earth Crystal.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

1394-2060-2265-5147-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Hardened Scales.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Hardened Scales.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Clone that has haste. Choose to have Clone enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.

250-779-1479-1669-6662.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-6662.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-2841-3585-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-3585-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

141-5686-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5686-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the Merfolk's ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

1274-3490-4050-4476.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.

Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.

112-565-5334.easyPrerequisites: any creature type chosen with Roaming Throne.
112-565-5334.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
112-565-5334.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Roaming Throne.
Orvar triggers twice, creating two token copies of Roaming Throne.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Roaming Throne.
Orvar triggers four times, creating four token copies of Roaming Throne.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting any nonlegendary permanent you control that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
Orvar triggers eight times, creating eight copies of the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Activate four of the copies of the mana-producing permanent by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 7.

Morrite of the Frost's enters-the-battlefield ability and Arcbound Crusher trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Crusher trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Staff of Eden.
Repeat from step 2.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Sea Tyrant of Segovia.

Play any land from your hand.

Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the land's power.
Resolve the land's trigger from step 3, causing you to put the land onto the battlefield from your hand, draw a card, and then decline to put another land onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Geralf's Messenger's undying ability and Mortician Beetle trigger.
Resolve the Geralf's Messenger trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 and a vigilance counter.

Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger, adding {C}{C}.
Geralf's Messenger's undying ability and Mortician Beetle trigger.
Resolve the Geralf's Messenger trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 and a vigilance counter.
Geralf's Messenger enters the battlefield, causing target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Mortician Beetle trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger, adding {C}{C}.
Mortician Beetle triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 6, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Geralf's Messenger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Geralf's Messenger enters the battlefield, causing target opponent to lose 2 life.
